task.title: P6-054: Route set_holding_quantity(0) deletion through the ledger
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-054. Size: M, decision first. Specs: specs/collection-api.md.

**`set_holding_quantity(id, 0)` still `DELETE`s the row with no ledger entry.** `hosted.rs:702-714`, no `append_move`. Still unreachable from the UI — the stepper intercepts `to == 0` and routes through `remove_holding` (`collection.rs:1557-1561`) — so this is a loaded gun with no finger on it rather than a live defect. The clean fix is routing quantity *decrements* through the ledger too; making only the 0 case a move would be a new inconsistency, so it is a spec-owner call rather than an obvious patch.
